text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, while going along with Daitaku Helios's
spur-of-the-moment hype...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone, everyone—"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Yooo, if it isn't Heli-poyo!
'Sup!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Good work, yeeeaaah!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: C'mon, try out the lottery! Woo☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sweet!
It feels kinda rare! In a way, it's totally fresh!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
The opposite...?
By the way, Helipoyo, do you have tickets?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, I don't know!
I just feel like we'll find it if we search!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios turned her pockets inside out.
After pulling out dagashi shop receipts, gum, lollipops,
broken hair ties, and purikura photo stickers...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Found it~~~~!!
Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios spun the raffle drum
with mega hype!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hot springs!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Holy crap,
am I a god or what!?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Heli-poyo!
I wonder if they'll like it, though.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
There really is nothing there except the hot springs.
For young girls like Helipoyo, it might be boring, though...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!
I seriously love hot springs!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, just getting to hype it up is the best☆
Plus Trainy's here too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes☆
We've been besties forever, haven't we?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Leaving you behind?
No way, that's not happening! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So yeah!
Pops, you wanna come too?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Huh!? N-No way, old guys aren't cute, are they!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Lol! We've always been the upbeat shopping district duo,
haven't we~?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Well, that might be true, but...
T-Trainer... are you really okay with this?
choice_data_list: She's just that kind of girl, so...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, shouldn't we rent out the whole inn!?
Hot spring fest! Am I a genius or what~!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Invite all the homies! Maybe even hit up that brutal 100-degree hell hot spring course—totes down for that!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, Daitaku Helios's ideas kept expanding—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Gotcha!
First, Trainer-pi and I will go scout the place out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To ensure the Hot Springs Festival would be held under the best conditions,
I managed to wrap up the chaotic discussion by framing this trip as a preliminary scouting visit.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Tecchan from the flower shop!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Still, pretty impressive, Trainer! Guiding Helios's feelings so well... Not just anyone could pull off an Onsen Festival, after all.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Huh? W-Wait, so you...
really only came to check the place out?
choice_data_list: Because it looks like fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
...I'm surprised. You really are...
Helios-chan's Trainer, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Trainy-P~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tetchan said he'd give us some flowers!
What kind do you want!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I'd rather just buy a bunch more
and go for a full-on samba vibe!
choice_data_list: I'm on my way, so stop right there!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Man... that really is love, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa!
Looks so yummy~!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah shoot, drool.
choice_data_list: Put it away, put it away.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Roger that!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, isn't this shape way too Insta-worthy!?
As expected from the party town's Insta-master☆

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, right? I was hoping everyone would
enjoy it~ Though nobody's really talking about it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Seriously, something like this is gonna go viral!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Take a pic☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Posting right away~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh!
So gooood~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Try some too, Trainy-P!
Ah, take a photo first! For my Story!
choice_data_list: Is it fine to just take a normal photo?
Should I just take a normal photo?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Takashi!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Like this, then~ while dancing~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Next is UmaTalk~♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sooooo yummyyyy~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios ate plenty and took lots of photos.
As a result—

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
—I'd like to draw a lottery ticket, please!
I'm aiming for the premium salisbury steak... *drool*!

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text: Me too! Me threeee!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Th-Things got busy all of a sudden!? Heheh, what a blessing! Alright, let's keep 'em co-ming!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, you're laying it on way too thick☆
That's a whole mountain of fan service!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
...Is this maybe a bit too much after all?
It's gonna be a pain to carry back, too.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about this lately.
I do things thinking it's for the best, but I wonder if I'm just forcing my feelings onto others.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's not true!
The more of everything, the better!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: You really think so...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real!?
You doubtin' me!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: First off, just leave it to this party animal☆

text_block_list.name: Helios's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the treat, Helios!
This carrot is so good!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right!?
Eat some more!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... amazing,
more and more friends are gathering...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Mister!
These carrots are going totally viral!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Everyone said it was super good~!
Piling up toppings is the absolute best, right?☆

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You got that right!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
Heli-poyo really is such a good girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, accompanied by the Umamusume's smiles, the mountain of carrots vanished in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
One streeeech!
Pop-po-poooon☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright, pretend this is a mic~
Take it, Pippi☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alright, interview me!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Anything's fiine☆
Hurry, hurry!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Um,
I'm so hungrrr—!
choice_data_list: What would you like to eat?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Noodles!
Udon, ramen, or soba!
choice_data_list: If you had to pick from among those, what would it be?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hmm! That's a great question!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotta go with ramen!
One of those super Insta-worthy ones loaded with mountains of chashu☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alright, next!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, people kept pressing for questions—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so down with white bean paste!
Alrighty, hit me with the next question! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Until you've had your fill—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, she continued playing the mysterious interviewer for a while even after we arrived at the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: A losing ticket...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tbh, aren't pocket tissues super useful??
It's totally not a dud prize!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Chin up, old man!
Uh, what was the top prize again...?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh, for real?
Did I maybe win a hot springs trip or something!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't watching at all!
Fr? Uh, as if...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pien!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios suffered a delayed-reaction
disappointment, tearing up in sadness...
